BrochureContent.Content:
Liam Reilly Auctioneers are delighted to present No. 903 Highfield Park, Kilcock, Co. Kildare to the market for sale.

This excellent three-bedroom mid-terrace residence comes to the market in very good condition throughout and offers an ideal opportunity for first-time buyers, those looking to trade down or investors seeking a quality property in a highly desirable location.

Extending to approximately 76.34 sq. m. (821 sq. ft.), the property has been well maintained and provides bright, well-proportioned accommodation throughout.

The accommodation briefly comprises:
•Entrance Hall
•Living Room 4.2m x 3.1m
•Kitchen / Dining Area 5.0m x 3.4m
•Bedroom 1 3.4m x 2.6m
•Bedroom 2 4.2m x 2.8m
•Bedroom 3 3.0m x 2.1m
•Family Bathroom

The property is presented in very good decorative order, allowing the successful purchaser to move in with minimal expense. The well-designed layout, bright living accommodation and generous bedroom sizes combine to create an ideal home for modern family living.

A particular feature of this property is its exceptionally long rear garden, offering enormous potential for those with green fingers or anyone wishing to create a beautiful outdoor living space. Whether it's landscaped gardens, raised flower beds, a vegetable garden, a children's play area or even a garden room (subject to the necessary planning permission), the generous rear garden provides endless possibilities and is a rare feature for a property of this type.

Highfield Park is one of Kilcock's most established and sought-after residential developments, renowned for its family-friendly atmosphere and convenient location. The property is within walking distance of Kilcock town centre, where an excellent range of amenities are available including supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, schools, pharmacies, sports clubs and a variety of local retailers. The town also benefits from excellent recreational facilities, including the Royal Canal Greenway, providing scenic walking and cycling routes.

For commuters, the location is second to none. Kilcock Train Station is within easy walking distance and offers regular rail services to Dublin City Centre and the surrounding commuter belt. An excellent TFI bus service also operates through the town, providing further public transport options. The nearby M4 motorway is just minutes away, offering convenient access to Maynooth, Leixlip, Lucan, the M50, Dublin City Centre and Dublin Airport, while also providing easy connectivity to the west of Ireland.

Kilcock continues to grow in popularity due to its excellent transport links, strong community spirit and proximity to major employment hubs, making it an outstanding location for both homeowners and investors.

Properties of this quality in Highfield Park rarely remain on the market for long. Combining spacious accommodation, excellent presentation, an exceptionally large rear garden and a superb location, No. 903 represents an outstanding opportunity for purchasers seeking a home with immediate comfort and future potential.

Viewing is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment with Liam Reilly Auctioneers.


LIAM REILLY AUCTIONEERS give notice that all descriptions, dimensions, references to condition and necessary permissions for use and occupation, and other details are given in good faith and are believed to be correct, but any intending purchasers should not rely on them as statements or representations of fact but must satisfy themselves by inspection or otherwise as to the correctness of each of them.
